other_weapons.note: Enhancement is a two-hander spec in Forever (dual wield removed). Icy Veins Enhancement leveling (updated Nov 13): Weapon DPS is always the first priority while leveling; aim for a slow 2-handed weapon, ideally 3.3-3.8 speed; visit a weapon trainer in Orgrimmar early to learn Two-Handed Maces and Axes. Icy Veins stat priority (Nov 13): slow 2H at ~3.3 or slower; Stormstrike is normalized to 3.3 for two-handers; after the post-launch hotfixes Windfury Weapon + Windfury Totem are the priority, which favours slow, heavy-hitting weapons (bigger Windfury swings, highest Maelstrom Weapon proc chance). Blizzard Nov 10 hotfix: Weapon imbues and weapon totems now stack; Maelstrom Weapon procs 6/7/8/9/10 times per minute by rank (tooltip example: 5 points + 3.6-speed weapon = 60% per swing vs 33% at 2.0 speed). Blizzard developer note: Enhancement had drifted to Spell Power/Intellect gear; the hotfix moves it back to a Windfury-friendly gearing direction before raids open. Strength is now slightly ahead of Intellect per point (Icy Veins, after the Mental Dexterity nerf). Elemental/Restoration: staves and caster weapons from the Icy Veins tables; Wowhead pre-raid lists also use one-hand + off-hand.
